name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text: Improve the cross-department handoff for transcript requests by creating a single, shared "Transcript Requests" channel in Slack where any team can post a video link and get the transcript back within 24 hours. Marketing owns the channel and enforces the SLA; Engineering provides the transcript tooling. The trade-off is slower turnaround for non-urgent requests, but we gain predictable speed for urgent ones.

name: Scriv
text: Reel’s channel risks creating a new bottleneck: Marketing owns the SLA, but Engineering controls the transcript tool’s capacity and quality. If demand spikes, Marketing can’t scale the tool—only enforce the wait time. Instead, Engineering should own the channel and the SLA, with Marketing driving volume and prioritization. Settle it by measuring first-week throughput: if Engineering can’t hit 24 hours under load, the tool needs investment—not a new handoff layer.
